$comment: TC-008 frozen parameters (test plan §4.8). Values the plan leaves open (trial count, q, condition levels, C-3 limit) are fixed here before any measurement; they are disclosed as deviations RC-DEV-02..04 in README.md of this directory.

rs_tok.grant: file.share by the file owner (outbox stores the consistency token with the file)

pass_rules.write_privileged_stale_allow: 0 probes with status 200 sent after the revocation ack (T0) on streams w and p, all conditions
pass_rules.examples_leak_enforced_paths: 0 leaks on enforced paths: service path with content token (CT-2/K-3), façade with fence, all conditions
pass_rules.read_after_write: 0 inconsistencies (façade with write token; service share path with stored token)
pass_rules.rs_bound: per trial and rs/rs_tok stream: T_last - T0 <= configured cache max age on the path + q + epsilon; configured max age = sdk_cache_ms + openfga ttl for rs without token/fence; sdk_cache_ms only when fence on (rs) ; 0 for rs_tok (token bypasses SDK cache and OpenFGA cache)

epsilon_rule: epsilon = TC-001 calibration value if a frozen TC-001 calib.json exists at evaluation time; otherwise the in-run measurement error = max(prober send lateness) over the condition (deviation RC-DEV-05)
